scope: Spec 036 baseline PR #509 and its one workflow implementation PR only; no protection edits or test reduction.
rationale: Max explicitly accepted the fresh one-task ordinary merge-queue exception after disclosure that the live queue lacks a final-merge-SHA independent-review hold and normative restrict_updates. Frozen PR-head independent review may precede full required queue CI and final tested/landed SHA verification. This waives only the bounded ADR-0008 ASK intervention and final-SHA review mechanics; all technical findings are corrected, full checks and protections remain unchanged, and global governance is not amended.
compensating_measures: Independent frozen PR-head review before each enqueue; any head change invalidates that review.
Unchanged required Full CI and Docker Images test the generated merge-group SHA; verify main equals it at landing.
Record reviewed/tested/landed SHAs, before/after protection snapshots, complete tests, coverage, mutation identities and actual timings.
No secret/environment changes, protection weakening, product edits or test reduction; exception expires after the two landings or 2026-10-19.
